$comment: Provenance for community packages. Every file listed here is authored ONLY by the
loom-calendar-experience-authoring Skill and copied in byte-identically; hand-editing is
loom_ux_judges/test/community_package_provenance_test.dart hashes each package and compares it against this
manifest. A hand-edit fails that test loudly.
What this does and does not guarantee: it converts a silent edit into a deliberate one. A
determined editor can update both the file and this manifest -- but that shows up in review
as a package change with no dispatch behind it, which is exactly the thing worth noticing.
It replaces the chmod 444 convention, which git does not track and a fresh clone loses.
AFTER A SKILL REGENERATION: run app/packages/tooling/loom_ux_judges/tool/update_community_provenance.dart and commit the result
in the same commit as the package.
